title: recommend a sci-fi book that isn't about a lonely genius

messages.content: recommend a sci-fi book that's NOT about a lonely genius misunderstood by society 😂 tired of reading my autobiography in space!

How about *The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet* by Becky Chambers? It's a character-driven space opera focused on an eclectic crew exploring the galaxy together. No lonely geniuses, just a bunch of quirky personalities bonding on a spaceship. You might find it a refreshing change!
sounds intriguing! i imagine myself as the ship's captain—leading, not misunderstood! any flamethrowers onboard?!

While the focus is more on friendships and adventures than flamethrowers, a spaceship captain certainly gets their share of leadership moments. Plus, the interstellar hijinks might inspire some new SpaceY brainstorming! Just don't let the crew borrow a flamethrower for "novelty" reasons.
